description: This Java source file defines the class MyCloudProvider, a custom implementation of Android's DocumentsProvider. It manages a virtual file hierarchy stored in internal storage, exposing files and directories to the system for sharing, searching, and document management operations. The class includes methods for querying roots, documents, recent files, performing CRUD operations, generating MIME types, and handling file access, with an internal setup that preloads sample files.

classes.name: MyCloudProvider
classes.description: A custom Android DocumentsProvider that exposes internal storage files as a document hierarchy, supporting search, recent files, CRUD operations, and document queries.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the provider, sets up the base directory, and preloads dummy files into storage.

methods.name: queryRoots
methods.description: Returns a cursor representing the root directories of the provider, with metadata such as flags, title, MIME types, and available space.

methods.name: queryRecentDocuments
methods.description: Returns a cursor with the most recently modified files under a specified root, limited to a maximum number of results.

methods.name: querySearchDocuments
methods.description: Searches for files whose names contain the search query within a specified root.

methods.name: queryDocument
methods.description: Returns metadata about a specific document identified by its document ID.

methods.name: queryChildDocuments
methods.description: Lists the child documents of a directory represented by the parent document ID.

methods.name: openDocument
methods.description: Opens a file as a ParcelFileDescriptor in the specified mode, supporting read/write access.

methods.name: createDocument
methods.description: Creates a new file under the specified directory with a given MIME type and display name.

methods.name: deleteDocument
methods.description: Deletes a specified document/file.

methods.name: getDocumentType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for a specific document.

methods.name: openDocumentThumbnail
methods.description: Returns an AssetFileDescriptor for a thumbnail representation of a document, suitable for images.

methods.name: resolveRootProjection
methods.description: Resolves the columns to be returned for root queries, defaulting if null.

methods.name: resolveDocumentProjection
methods.description: Resolves the columns for document queries, defaulting if null.

methods.name: getTypeForFile
methods.description: Determines the MIME type of a file based on whether it is a directory or a filename extension.

methods.name: getTypeForName
methods.description: Determines the MIME type from a filename extension.

methods.name: getChildMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a string listing supported MIME types for a directory.

methods.name: getDocIdForFile
methods.description: Generates a consistent document ID from a File object based on its path relative to the root.

methods.name: includeFile
methods.description: Adds a file's metadata as a row in the given cursor.

methods.name: getFileForDocId
methods.description: Converts a document ID back into a corresponding File object within the storage hierarchy.

methods.name: writeDummyFilesToStorage
methods.description: Preloads sample files into internal storage to simulate cloud files.

methods.name: writeFileToInternalStorage
methods.description: Writes a resource file to internal storage with specified extension.

methods.name: getResourceIdArray
methods.description: Retrieves an array of resource IDs from a typed array resource.

methods.name: isUserLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks shared preferences to determine if a user is logged in.
